description: Launch the CyberBrick desktop app with the CDP debug port (9223). Reuses a reachable CDP endpoint. If the app is already running without the debug port, it fails unless kill_existing=true (the app enforces a single-instance lock) — killing it discards unsaved work, so get the user's OK first. NOTE: must run from an unsandboxed shell.

kill_existing.description: Kill a running CyberBrick instance (without the CDP port) before launching. Only with the user's OK — unsaved work is lost.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait for the CDP endpoint to come up.

name: cb_launch
